`HasCustomParsing` does not affect a `__declspec` spelling. It applies only to attributes with a GNU spelling, whose special arguments can be handled by `Parser::ParseGNUAttributeArgs()`.

Attributes using the `Declspec` spelling are handled by `Parser::ParseMicrosoftDeclSpec`, which currently ignores `HasCustomParsing`. `Declspec` denotes Microsoft-style `__declspec(attr)` syntax.
